mechanism: Cholecalciferol supplementation is required to maintain calcium homeostasis and prevent hypocalcemia when using denosumab, a RANKL inhibitor that suppresses bone resorption.
action: Ensure adequate vitamin D supplementation (cholecalciferol) and calcium intake during denosumab therapy; monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels regularly to prevent secondary hyperparathyroidism and hypocalcemia.
